name: jupiter-ultra-test-harness
description: Host-only test harness for live Jupiter/Solana integration tests (BAT-1013/1024/1025/1031) + BAT-697 contract probes + refund tools. Runs on developer machines ONLY — requires Node >=20.18 (incompatible with CI's Node 18 pin) and BURNER_SECRET_KEY (which is never a CI secret). NOT on the nodejs-mobile (Node 18 LTS) on-device runtime. Uses BURNER_SECRET_KEY from .env.test against real Jupiter mainnet. NEVER commit secrets.
